blocks.text: Upar wali rate equation mein exponents ‘x’ aur ‘y’ har reactant ke lihaz se reaction ka order (darja) batate hain.

blocks.title: Reaction ka order
blocks.text: Kisi khas reactant ke lihaz se reaction ka order woh exponent (taqat) hai jo rate equation mein us reactant ki concentration par laga hota hai.

Is tarah reaction A ke lihaz se order ‘x’ aur B ke lihaz se order ‘y’ ka hai. Reaction ka kul (overall) order (x + y) hai. Order batata hai ke reactant ki concentration rate par kaise asar karti hai. Sirf ek reactant ho to order bas rate equation mein us ki concentration ki taqat hai.
Chemical reactions zero, first, second aur third order mein taqseem hoti hain. Reaction ka order us ke mechanism (tareeqa-e-amal) ke bare mein qeemti maloomat deta hai.
Ek reactant ke lihaz se order aur poore reaction ke kul order mein farq samajhna bohat zaroori hai.
Misal ke taur par nitrogen (II) oxide (NO) aur hydrogen (H₂) ka reaction lein:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke NO, H₂ “aur oxygen” se react karta hai, lekin is reaction mein oxygen shamil nahi; sirf NO aur H₂ react karte hain. Kitab ki equation mein product sirf H₂O likha hai, jis se equation balanced nahi rehti (baen taraf 2 O atoms, daen taraf 1). Sahi: 2H₂(g) + 2NO(g) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(g).

items: H₂ ke lihaz se first-order hai
NO ke lihaz se second-order hai

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Reaction ka order rate equation mein concentrations par lage sab exponents ka majmooa (sum) hai. Order tajurbe (experiment) se maloom hota hai; sirf reaction ki equation dekh kar nahi nikala ja sakta. Rate equation ke exponents ka majmooa balanced equation ke coefficients ke barabar ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is misal mein H₂ ki concentration doguni karein to rate doguna hota hai (first-order). NO ki concentration doguni karein to rate chaar guna hota hai (second-order, kyun ke 2² = 4). Dhyan dein: equation mein H₂ ka coefficient 2 hai, phir bhi us ka order 1 hai; order hamesha tajurbe se aata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Rate law se reaction ka order kaise nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Har reactant ka order rate law mein us ki concentration ki taqat (exponent) hai, aur kul order in sab taqaton ka majmooa. rate = k[H₂][NO]² mein H₂ ka order 1, NO ka 2 aur kul order 3 hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Specific rate (rate constant) kya hai aur rate equation mein kaise likha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Rate constant k rate equation ka tanasub (proportionality) constant hai: rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ. Jab har reactant ki concentration 1 mol dm⁻³ ho to rate = k; isi liye ise specific rate kehte hain. Yeh temperature ke saath badalta hai.

items: Reactant ka order = rate law mein us ka exponent; kul order = exponents ka majmooa.
rate = k[H₂][NO]²: H₂ ke lihaz se 1, NO ke lihaz se 2, kul 3.
Order tajurbe se maloom hota hai, equation ke coefficients se nahi.
